evaluation.legacy_field_rollout_mse_20: alias only; actual horizon is 12 coarse steps

excluded_configurations.reason: Reflection x -> -x is not a symmetry of the tilted Hamiltonian; quotient control is inapplicable.

evaluation.both_enclose_definition: fraction of seeds with at least one left and one right sampled polygon enclosing zero
evaluation.winding_limitation: finite trajectories are polygon-closed; not a completeness certificate
evaluation.quotient_control: explicit E(x)=E(-x), reconstruction and prediction only up to reflection; symmetric potentials only

evaluation.scalar_readout_input: time mean of total Euclidean radius
evaluation.two_block_readout_input: two time-mean planar block radii for every model
evaluation.readout: degree-two ridge, lambda=1e-4, training standardization and fit; untruncated test R2
